description: Check the learner's answer to one practice problem and record it, or several problems at once with `answers` (up to 20 pairs of problem id and letter). Returns, per problem, whether it was correct, the correct option, the worked solution and the cited conversion sheet line. The problem id identifies its exam (grade). Side effects: creates the learner's account on first use, saves the attempt to the learner's progress for that grade (mastery per topic and the review schedule; missed problems come back later) and adds a usage record. Overwrites and deletes nothing. Limit: at most 40 answers per minute per account; over it, nothing is recorded and the call can be retried a moment later. Calling it again for the same problem records another attempt, so call it once per answer the user gives. Problems that are part of an open timed set can't be checked until that set is submitted.

answer.description: The letter the user chose, e.g. "B" (single form)

answers.description: Several answers at once: [{ questionId, answer }, ...] in the order the user gave them (batch form)

questionId.description: The problem id from practice_questions (single form)

name: check_answer
title: Check an answer
